---
title: "Manifest"
subtitle: "Every document in the wiki and every source it links to."
toc: true
page-layout: full
---

```{r}
source("R/helpers.R")
statutes <- load_statutes()
sources  <- build_sources(statutes)
refs     <- readr::read_csv("data/reference_sources.csv", col_types = "cccc")

page_link <- function(id, text) {
  paste0("<a href=\"statutes/", id, ".html\">", text, "</a>")
}

ext_link <- function(url, text) {
  paste0("<a href=\"", url, "\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">", text, "</a>")
}

# shared table settings, with copy and CSV export buttons
manifest_table <- function(df) {
  DT::datatable(
    df,
    escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(dom = "Bfrtip", buttons = c("copy", "csv"), pageLength = 20)
  )
}
```

The manifest is rebuilt from `data/` on every render, so it always matches the pages. The same tables are saved as plain files: [manifest_documents.csv](data/manifest_documents.csv) and [manifest_sources.csv](data/manifest_sources.csv).

## Documents

One row per statute, `r nrow(statutes)` in all.

```{r}
statutes |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Statute = page_link(id, title),
    Year = year,
    Domain = factor(domain_label),
    Status = factor(status_label),
    `Public law` = public_law,
    `Statutes at Large` = stat,
    `U.S. Code` = usc,
    `Code titles` = purrr::map_chr(usc_titles, \(x) paste(x, collapse = ", ")),
    ID = id
  ) |>
  manifest_table()
```

## Source links

One row per link, `r nrow(sources)` in all. Primary links are built from each statute's citation; secondary links are the reports and articles used for current-status notes.

```{r}
sources |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(statutes, statute_id = id, short), by = "statute_id") |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Statute = page_link(statute_id, short),
    Type = factor(source_type),
    Source = ext_link(url, label)
  ) |>
  manifest_table()
```

## Reference sources

General sources used across the wiki and worth checking first when verifying or extending a page.

```{r}
refs |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Source = ext_link(url, name),
    Type = type,
    `Used for` = used_for
  ) |>
  DT::datatable(escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 50))
```

## Project files

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `data/statutes/*.yml` | The wiki content, one entry per statute, in files grouped by domain, plus one for Title 10 operational authorities and one for foundations. |
| `data/edges.csv` | The knowledge graph: one row per relationship between two statutes. |
| `data/reference_sources.csv` | The general reference sources listed above. |
| `data/member.yml` | The member the wiki is tailored to: committees, initiatives, and district interests, each with its own source link. |
| `data/manifest_documents.csv` | Generated. The documents table above. |
| `data/manifest_sources.csv` | Generated. The source links table above. |
| `R/helpers.R` | Data loading, vocabularies, and citation link builders. |
| `R/build_pages.R` | Validates the data and writes `statutes/*.qmd` and the manifest files. |
| `statutes/*.qmd` | Generated. One wiki page per statute. |
| `index.qmd`, `graph.qmd`, `title10-title50.qmd`, `member.qmd`, `manifest.qmd`, `about.qmd` | The six top-level pages. |
| `CLAUDE_README.md` | Context file for working on this project in another Claude session. |
